name: placeholders-and-vanish-input
title: Vanish Placeholder Input
description: A rounded ask-anything field that cycles grey suggestion prompts every few seconds. Typing switches to white text and lights an arrow button, and submitting scatters the words into particles.
use: A search or ask field should feel playful and clear itself with a flourish after submit.
avoid: The dissolve needs a canvas and steady frame rate, and it wipes the typed value after submit.
a11y: The field has no label or aria-label, the arrow button has no name, and the text dissolve ignores reduced-motion. (keyboard: yes, labels: none, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A pill-shaped dark grey field with a grey prompt inside and a small circular arrow button at its right end, sitting under a short white heading on a black stage. Typed text is white.
behaves: The prompt fades upward and swaps to the next suggestion on a timer. Typing replaces it with white text and enables the arrow; submitting breaks the text into a cloud of dots that scatters sideways before the field empties.
customise: Pass the placeholders array and onChange and onSubmit handlers. The three-second cycle, pill styling and particle dissolve are fixed in the file.
weight: moderate: An 800px canvas is rescanned on every text change, with particles animated on submit.
